title: Build and Deploy Workflow
content: Complete workflow to build, test, and deploy projects from local to hosting.

items.title: Prepare for build
items.why: Ensure code is ready for release
items.what: Run tests and validation before build
items.how: make test && make validate — Both must pass before proceeding

items.title: Build project
items.what: Generate build-output folder with all necessary files
items.how: make build project=<name> version=<X.Y.Z> — Creates projects/<name>/build-output/ with .release-manifest.json

items.title: Verify build output
items.how: ls -la projects/<name>/build-output/ — Verify www/, data/, and .release-manifest.json exist

items.title: Review manifest
items.what: Check version, git info, changes count, rollback info

items.title: Push to git with tagging
items.why: Version control and enable rollback capability
items.what: Commit code, create git tag, push to remote
items.how: make push project=<name> version=vX.Y.Z branch=<main|staging> msg='Release description' — Creates tag and pushes

items.title: Verify git tag
items.how: git tag -l vX.Y.Z — Should show the tag you just created

items.title: Pull on hosting
items.what: SSH to hosting, pull latest code from git
items.how: On hosting: git pull origin <branch> — Downloads new version

items.title: Run migrations (if any)
items.what: Execute migration scripts included in deployment

items.title: Create database backup
items.why: Enable rollback to previous data state
items.how: On hosting: make backup-database version=vX.Y.Z paths='database/local data/' — Creates backups/vX.Y.Z-backup.tar.gz

items.title: Verify deployment
items.how: Open application URL, test key features, check logs for errors

items.title: Log deployment
items.how: make history-add action='deploy' msg='vX.Y.Z deployed to <server>' — Logs timestamp and details

items.title: Cleanup local build
items.why: Free disk space (code already in git)
items.what: Delete build-output folder after successful push
items.how: rm -rf projects/<name>/build-output/ — Optional, can keep for reference
